verdict.rationale: An online government service portal (UTR/UTS tax filing, job and child-care search) could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows any AI-generated analysis or suggestions from a user's data. The monthly 'useful hints' are general editorial tips from the Tax Department, not AI insights drawn from the user's own data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
